properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: OpenSSL primitives via openssl@0.10.81 — the vendored OpenSSL build (root Cargo.toml:119) backing native-tls for sncast's HTTPS JSON-RPC sessions. Same logical asset as LIB-84f9e41d (the openssl crate in the lockfile), viewed as the algorithm surface it provides. Its TLS handshakes negotiate classical ECDHE (X25519/P-256) key exchange; no PQ hybrid groups.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: TLS 1.3 via rustls@0.23.45 — same asset as LIB-da9e9820 viewed as the protocol version it provides. TLS 1.3 sessions negotiate X25519/ECDHE key exchange (ring provider); no PQ hybrid groups (X25519MLKEM768) are enabled by this stack. The HTTPS sessions concerned are sncast CLI calls to user-configured Starknet JSON-RPC endpoints — harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure is limited to that operator's own RPC traffic, and the fix is a rustls/provider upgrade, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: native-tls@0.2.18 in the resolved build — the default TLS backend of reqwest (workspace Cargo.toml:117, features=["json"] with defaults on), used for sncast's HTTPS JSON-RPC provider sessions to Starknet nodes. On Linux it delegates to OpenSSL (vendored, see LIB-84f9e41d). TLS posture: classical ECDHE key exchange; PQ hybrid groups unavailable through this backend. Changeable here by switching the HTTP client to a rustls backend that offers X25519MLKEM768.
